response.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS left_over FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.event_status, s.avg_left_over, s.avg_left_over - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM (SELECT event_status, AVG(left_over) AS avg_left_over FROM l GROUP BY event_status) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(left_over) AS overall_avg FROM l) o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Leftover is computed as amount - spent per budget row, and rows where either amount or spent is NULL are excluded from both the per-status and the overall averages.
The overall average is the average leftover across all qualifying budget rows (row-weighted), not the average of the per-status averages.
